activityDescription: Ham Radio Workbenches On The Air
sending: Sends contacts and status to the tracker when the operation's call is {{call}}
hostNoKey: Enter your logger key under Settings › Accounts › HRWBOTA
accountDescription: HRWBOTA hosts send their contacts and status to the event's tracker with a logger key. Make one on your host card at tracker.hrwbota.com/admin.
accountNotHost: Only HRWBOTA hosts need a key. {{call}} is not on the host list, so there is nothing to set up: spots and scoring work without one.
accountNoCall: Only HRWBOTA hosts need a key. Set your callsign in your operator profile first.
keyPostface: Starts with hrwb_. Shown once when you make it on your host card.
keyRefused: The tracker does not know this key, or it was revoked. Make a new one on your host card.
checkFailed: Could not check the key (HTTP {{status}}). Try again later.
connectedAsOther: Connected as {{call}} ({{name}}), but your profile's callsign is {{profileCall}}: contacts go out only from operations under {{call}}.
noKey: This operation carries the HRWBOTA activity, but no logger key is set, so its contacts are not going to the tracker. Enter it under Settings › Accounts › HRWBOTA.
rejected: The tracker refused the contact with {{call}}: {{message}}
spotSent: Status sent to the HRWBOTA tracker
spotFailed: The HRWBOTA tracker did not take the status: {{message}}
spotUnreachable: Could not reach the HRWBOTA tracker
wrongKey: The logger key is {{owner}}'s, so contacts logged as {{call}} are not sent: they would count for {{owner}}. Log as {{owner}}, or enter {{call}}'s key.
wrongKeySpot: The logger key is {{owner}}'s, not {{call}}'s: the tracker would show {{owner}} on the air.
batchRefused: The tracker refused a batch of contacts: {{message}}
statusRefused: The tracker did not take your status: {{message}}
unreachable: The HRWBOTA tracker has not answered for a while. Your contacts are kept and go out when it answers, as long as the app stays open.
